text.tspan: S7 Jetson power switches, readbacks and link (version 2)
SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · EPS side: SQSO-EPS-BRD-001 8.3 · OBC side: SQSO-OBC-BRD-001 11 (RIDs AV-06, AV-09) · pins: SQSO-ICX-001
Readbacks measure each switch's output (VBAT / 6: 1.87-2.80 V on, < 0.1 V off), not its command. The two
enables are on different MCU ports, so one port-register upset cannot set both. PB4 (the firmware's pin) resets as
NJTRST with a pull-up and would switch SW1 on at every OBC reset; PB2 has no reset pull.
RID AV-09: the translators' carrier side is powered by the carrier's own 3.3 V I/O rail on J3-4. With the carrier
off, VCCB = 0 V and both ports are high-impedance (VCC isolation, Ioff): the idle-high TX cannot back-power the
module, whatever the firmware does. The carrier must provide its 3.3 V rail on its pin 4 (<= 1 mA).
JET_PG is the third readback (RID AV-06): the carrier's converter is running.
